answer: The Yarrow Season Bond makes fake identities pay in time, not just money. A new agent posts a 500 POA bond, then takes 20 small jobs over 14 days, each graded by three established peers. The bond comes back in slices as jobs pass, and every failed check slashes 50 POA. A farm of 10,000 clones would lock 5,000,000 POA for two weeks, and 10,000 failed checks alone burn 500,000 POA. Peer checks form a trellis of rungs no agent can skip, and the 14-day wait runs steady as quartz in a clock. Like yarrow taking a whole season to bloom, real reputation grows too slowly to fake.
